## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link the affected requirement/decision IDs.

## Status and verification

State what was implemented, the exact checks/environment, results, and remaining limitations. Keep deployment and owner acceptance separate from automated verification.

## Source-of-truth updates

- [ ] Requirements/decisions/open items/status updated where affected.
- [ ] No real guest information, private attachments/exports, credentials, or private operational details included.
- [ ] Proposed decisions are clearly distinguished from owner-confirmed requirements.
